title: Panic during queries with MariaDB
body: ### Rust Version 1.91.1 ### Diesel Version 2.3.4 ### Diesel Features "chrono", "r2d2", "numeric" ### Database Version MariaDB v11 or v12 (Connnector/C v3.4.5 and newer tested) ### Operating System Version Debian Trixie ### What happened? Wanted to test out the new fix for MariaDB in the v3.3.4 release of Diesel with Vaultwarden. Migrations worked fine, but creating an account or logging in is broken. Tried to use v2.3.3 of Diesel together with the Connector/C v3.4.5 and newer, all works fine (except the newer client lib versions crash with specific conditions of course) ``` [panic][ERROR] thread 'rocket-worker-thread' panicked at 'Libmysqlclient reported a larger size for a fixed size buffer without setting the truncated flag. This is a bug somewhere. Please open an issue with reproduction steps at https://github.com/diesel-rs/diesel/issues/new Length: 48, Capacity: 48, Type: MYSQL_TYPE_DATETIME': No panic ### Additional details Didn't tried to create an example yet, as i have no time right now. Maybe it's easy reproducible. ### Steps to reproduce ```rust 1. Pull Vaultwarden repo (github.com/dani-garcia/vaultwarden) 2. Update all the crates 3. run `CARGO_PROFILE=dev docker/bake.sh debian-amd64` 4. Start the container, something like this docker run --rm -it \ -e DISABLE_ADMIN_TOKEN=true \ -e I_REALLY_WANT_VOLATILE_STORAGE=true \ -e LOG_LEVEL=debug \ -e ROCKET_PORT=8080 \ -e DOMAIN='http://localhost:8080' \ -e DATABASE_URL="mysql://user:pass@127.0.0.1:3306/vw" \ --network=host \ vaultwarden/server:testing-amd64 ``` ### Compile time error None ### Checklist - [x] I have already looked over the [issue tracker](https://github.com/diesel-rs/diesel/issues) and the [discussion forum](https://github.com/diesel-rs/diesel/discussions) for similar possible closed issues. - [x] This issue can be reproduced on Rust's stable channel.
